labels.anchor_text: all provided by Dr. Adi F. Gazdar
labels.rationale: A named person is a provenance statement, not an obtainable source. No repository, no catalogue number and no RRID for any of the six lines, and the Hamon Center NSCLC lines do carry RRIDs. The normal lung fibroblasts and cancer-associated fibroblasts are described only as obtained from a normal lung specimen and a lung cancer specimen, with no source, no consent statement and no ethics approval. The three derived resistant lines are novel and undeposited. Unlike the Dos Santos case at AMB-113, this one was avoidable at publication.

labels.anchor_text: These fibroblasts were used in passages 5 through 7.
labels.rationale: The field is answered exactly right for the fibroblasts, with a tight range and a clear reason, and not at all for the eleven other lines. Non-blocking for the immortalised NSCLC lines. Recorded partly because it is the third instance of one field holding two different verdicts inside one paper, after centrifugation.force in Dos Santos and antibody.identifier in Yadav.

A 43% range on the readout window of a proliferation assay, repeated in the Figure 3A, 3C, 4C, 4D and 5A legends. Cell viability compounds with time, so a plate read at day 7 and one read at day 10 give materially different percentages, and these percentages are the primary quantitative results with asterisks attached. Third use of GAP_RANGE_NOT_POINT in the corpus and the clearest blocking case of the three. Note separately that the rhOSM pretreatment duration is given as 2 weeks in the text, at least 2 weeks in the Figure 3 legends, 4 weeks in Figure 2D and 1 week in Figures 2E and 2F, and the dose as 1 ng/mL in some panels and 10 ng/mL in others. See AMB-132.

labels.anchor_text: The primary antibodies were as follows
labels.rationale: Roughly twenty antibodies are listed with a vendor and nothing else. No catalogue number, no RRID and no dilution for any of them. One clone name appears, R28 for vimentin, which shows the information was available and not reported for the rest. Phospho-specific antibodies against JAK1, JAK2 and STAT3 are the primary readout of the paper and several distinct products exist for each. Same blanket vendor pattern as the Xiong paper, and worse, because dilutions are also missing. See AMB-129.

labels.anchor_text: exposure to a specific targeted drug according to a previously reported method
labels.anchor_section: Results, IL6 proinflammatory pathway is activated in NSCLC cells
labels.rationale: The three resistant lines H23-SR, HCC4006-ER and H3122-CR are the central resource of the paper, and their derivation is one clause deferred to reference 20 plus the phrase more than 4 months of drug exposure. No starting dose, no escalation schedule, no maintenance concentration, no passage count and no cloning step. The derivation is also the only part of the study that cannot be replaced by buying a reagent.

labels.anchor_text: cells were transfected with Silencer Select siRNA against
labels.anchor_section: Intracellular kinase activation after cytokine treatment
labels.rationale: The product line is named and nothing else: no catalogue number for any of the seven targets, no transfection reagent, no method, no medium and no incubation time before the stated 72 hour endpoint. Transfection is one of the two interventions in the paper and is used in Figures 2C, 2F, 3C and 5A.

labels.anchor_text: PCR amplification was conducted on an ABI Real-Time PCR 7900 HT
labels.anchor_section: mRNA and miRNA expression analysis by qRT-PCR
labels.rationale: The instrument and the quantitation method are given. RNA extraction, RNA input, DNase treatment, reverse transcription, the separate chemistry required for miRNA, master mix and cycling conditions are all absent. Three replicates per sample is stated, which is the one MIQE item the section answers.

labels.anchor_text: To detect specific signals, the membranes were examined by Western Lightning Plus-ECL
labels.rationale: The section is an antibody list and a detection reagent. No lysis buffer, no protein quantitation, no load, no gel, no transfer, no membrane, no blocking agent and no incubation conditions. Compare the Xiong paper, which gives the lysis reagent, the load and the membrane while failing on antibody identity: the two papers fail opposite halves of the same method.

labels.anchor_text: Each experiment was performed at least in triplicate, and three times independently.
labels.rationale: This sentence is close to exactly right: it separates technical from independent replication, which almost no paper does. The defect is that at least in triplicate is an open lower bound rather than a number, and that the statement covers only the proliferation assays. The Western blots, the ELISA and the phospho-kinase array carry no replication statement at all. Marked non-blocking because the assays that carry the P values are the ones covered. Low confidence: a reviewer may reasonably call this a pass.
